entries.competence: The students demonstrate, respect for human rights and individuals dignity.
entries.objective: Demonstrate the ability to recognize and respect human rights and dignity.
entries.teaching_act: -The teacher to guide the students in groups to read the universal declaration on human rights, discuss and summarize the various aspect of human rights. -The teacher to guide students on the importance of human rights in our society. -The teacher guide students to explain and discuss how human rights are related to the provision of basic needs.
entries.learning_act: -The students in groups to present their summaries in class for discussion and clarification. -Students to make group presentations on the importance of human rights.
entries.materials: Copies of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. Copies of the Constitution of the United Republic of Tanzania.
entries.assessment: Explain the importance of human rights in our society. Relate people’s human rights to the provision of their basic needs.

entries.competence: The students demonstrate, respect for human rights and individuals dignity.
entries.objective: Demonstrate the ability to recognize and respect human rights and dignity.
entries.teaching_act: -The teacher to guide students to brainstorm on the meaning of limitations of individual human rights. -To guide the students to discuss the purposes of limiting individuals human rights.
entries.materials: List of limitations of individuals human rights.
entries.assessment: i) Explain the meaning ii) Explain the purpose of putting limitations on individual human rights.

entries.teaching_act: The teacher to guide students to brainstorm on the meaning of abuse of human rights. Effects of human rights abuse in Tanzania. How to combat human rights abuse. Differences between limitations of individual human rights and abuses of human rights.
entries.materials: Articles or pictures on the abuse limitations of human rights.
entries.assessment: Differentiate between limitations of individual human rights and abuse of human rights.
